Spirii is hiring! We are looking for a Commercial Director to lead our eMSP business.

About Spirii

Spirii was founded in Copenhagen in 2019 with one goal: to make EV charging simple. Today, our software helps charge point operators and businesses in more than 22 markets run and grow their charging networks. Since 2024, we have been part of the Edenred Group, which gives us strong support and a close link to company fleets across Europe. Our next chapter is eMSP, and we are looking for the person to lead it.

Position Overview

The Commercial Director eMSP will lead Spirii's commercial strategy and execution for our eMobility Service Provider (eMSP) platform across our priority European markets (Denmark/Sweden, Germany, Netherlands, France, and Italy). As part of the sales leadership team, you will build and scale our eMSP business, serving as the commercial counterpart to our Mobility Product Director. This role requires an entrepreneurial leader who can develop new markets, close complex deals with fleet operators and mobility service providers, and establish Spirii as a leading eMSP competitor.

You will build a new dedicated eMSP sales team while collaborating closely with existing regional sales managers who sell eMSP as an adjacency to CPMS, and partnering with product and operations teams to deliver integrated mobility solutions.

Key Responsibilities

Commercial Strategy & Leadership

• 
Develop and execute the commercial strategy for Spirii's eMSP product line across priority markets

• 
Define market segmentation, go-to-market approach, and competitive positioning for Spirii’s focus markets

• 
Serve as the commercial voice in eMSP governance, partnering with the Mobility Product Director

• 
Contribute to product roadmap prioritization based on market insights and customer needs

• 
Establish revenue targets, pricing strategies, and business models for eMSP offerings

• 
Report progress, pipeline, and strategic recommendations to the Chief Sales Officer

• 
Represent Spirii eMSP at industry events, conferences, and with strategic partners

Business Development & Market Intelligence

• 
Lead business development activities including mapping the eMSP ecosystem and understanding market movements

• 
Identify and qualify leads across priority European markets

• 
Build strategic relationships with fleet operators, leasing companies, retailers, and mobility providers

• 
Lead pursuit of major tenders requiring eMSP capabilities

• 
Develop partnership strategies with roaming networks, charge point operators, and technology providers

• 
Monitor competitive landscape and emerging trends in EV roaming and mobility services

• 
Generate qualified pipeline and convert opportunities to closed deals

Sales Team Leadership & Execution

• 
Build, lead, and develop a high-performing eMSP BD and sales team

• 
Personally close complex, strategic eMSP deals with C-level stakeholders

• 
Enable and support existing regional sales managers on eMSP specifics in their business deals

• 
Establish sales processes, methodologies, and enablement programs for eMSP

• 
Develop proposal templates, business cases, and ROI models for eMSP solutions

• 
Achieve/exceed annual revenue and customer acquisition targets

Cross-Functional Collaboration

• 
Partner with Mobility Product Director to align commercial needs with product development

• 
Collaborate with Roaming Operations team on customer success, issue resolution, and support

• 
Work with Finance on reconciliation processes, margin control, and pricing strategies

• 
Coordinate with Marketing on product marketing support for launch and go-to-market activities

• 
Align with Chief Sales Officer and sales leadership on integrated CPMS+eMSP strategies

• 
Engage with Legal on contract negotiations and deal structuring

• 
Provide market feedback to inform technical and operational priorities

Required Qualifications

Experience:

• 
8+ years in B2B sales or business development, with at least 3 years in leadership roles

• 
Proven track record in the EV charging, mobility services, fleet management, or energy sectors

• 
Experience selling complex SaaS or platform solutions to enterprise customers

• 
Demonstrated success building and scaling new business lines or products

• 
Experience operating across multiple European markets (particularly Denmark/Sweden, Germany, Netherlands, France, Italy)

• 
Track record of consistently achieving/exceeding revenue targets (€3M+ ARR)

Knowledge & Skills:

• 
Deep understanding of the EV charging ecosystem, including eMSP, CPMS, and roaming protocols (OCPI, OICP)

• 
Knowledge of fleet electrification trends and fleet operator business models

• 
Strong commercial acumen with ability to develop pricing strategies and business models

• 
Excellent stakeholder management and C-level selling skills

• 
Strategic thinking combined with hands-on execution capability

• 
Proven ability to build and lead small, high-performing teams

• 
Proficiency in CRM systems (Salesforce, HubSpot) and sales analytics

Personal Attributes:

• 
Entrepreneurial mindset with comfort in ambiguity and building from ground up

• 
Results-driven with strong accountability and ownership

• 
Collaborative leadership style with ability to work across sales, product, and operations

• 
Exceptional communication and presentation skills

• 
Cultural sensitivity and ability to work in diverse, international teams

• 
Resilience and adaptability in fast-paced, evolving markets

• 
Strong team player who can enable regional sales managers on eMSP topics

Languages:

• 
Fluent in English (required)

• 
Additional European languages (German, French, Dutch, Swedish, Danish, or Italian) highly desirable

Education:

• Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, or related field (Master's degree preferred)

Benefits

• 
Flexible Work Environment: Enjoy a collaborative, inclusive, and open workplace designed to fit your needs and support work-life balance

• 
Competitive Package: A competitive salary, an 11% company pension plan, and a comprehensive benefits package

• 
Time to Recharge: Benefit from 32 paid vacation days (5 weeks + 5 extra) and paid parental leave to focus on what matters most

• 
Career Growth: Access professional development opportunities and grow your career in a high-impact, high-growth industry

• 
Stay Energized: Enjoy excellent coffee, tea, free snacks, and subsidized lunches at the office

• 
Stay Active: Use our Spirii gym and shared company car to keep moving

• 
Make an Impact: Be part of a team driving the future of sustainable energy while working on meaningful projects

About Spirii

Spirii is a full-service e-Mobility provider, offering hardware and software charging solutions to companies in the private and public sector. Spirii recently celebrated its seven-year anniversary as a founded company — though the people at Spirii bring far more extensive experience working with electric cars and charging, and with the development of future transport and energy systems.

Spirii is an equal opportunity employer. We encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds and experiences. Spirii strives to create an inclusive and diverse workplace, and we encourage all qualified applicants to apply regardless of age, gender, race, sexual/religious orientation, or disability.

At Spirii, we are building world-class charging products and digital solutions for the future of mobility. Our Digital Development team drives a listen, learn, and lead culture that keeps us improving how we work and how we build.

We are now looking for a Cloud Engineer to join us on this journey. In this role, you will help our engineering teams embrace the DevOps mindset while designing and running our cloud setup. You will be part of building and maintaining a modern, scalable, and secure cloud platform that powers Spirii’s products.

You will report to our Engineering Manager and work closely with colleagues across our Engineering teams, both in-house and near-shore.

What you will be working on

• 
Build, operate, and improve Spirii’s AWS and Kubernetes (EKS) infrastructure to ensure reliability, scalability, and performance.

• 
Automate infrastructure provisioning with CDK for Terraform (CDKTF).

• 
Design and maintain CI/CD pipelines and developer tooling for fast, secure delivery.

• 
Collaborate with engineering teams to embed platform capabilities and DevOps best practices.

• 
Ensure security best practices and protect against threats across our cloud setup.

• 
Monitor infrastructure health and performance using tools like Datadog, Prometheus, Grafana, and CloudWatch.

• 
Troubleshoot and resolve issues across infrastructure, CI/CD, and runtime environments.

• 
Document processes for knowledge sharing and smooth onboarding.

• 
Contribute to incident management and disaster recovery processes.

Who you are

• 
You enjoy working hands-on with cloud infrastructure while enabling others to succeed.

• 
You bring a DevOps mindset and like to share your knowledge to drive adoption.

• 
You have a strong sense of ownership and pride in building quality solutions.

• 
You communicate clearly and collaborate easily across teams.

• 
You care about developer experience and making platforms easy to use.

• 
You contribute to an open, friendly, and collaborative team culture.

What you bring

Must-have

• 
A degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent experience.

• 
4+ years in a Cloud/DevOps/Platform Engineer role.

• 
Strong experience with AWS (EKS, RDS, S3, CloudFront, IAM, etc.) and security best practices.

• 
Kubernetes (EKS) administration and operations.

• 
Infrastructure as code with Terraform or CDKTF.

• 
CI/CD pipeline design and maintenance (GitHub Actions or similar).

• 
Linux/Unix systems and scripting with TypeScript.

• 
Monitoring and observability tools (Datadog, Prometheus, Grafana, CloudWatch).

• 
Excellent troubleshooting skills.

Nice-to-have

• 
Experience with platform development (shared services, APIs).

• 
Working with SQL and NoSQL databases.

• 
Knowledge of security architecture for cloud-native applications.

Benefits

It is important for us to create a healthy, diverse, fun, and creative working environment, so besides all the basic benefits, we also focus a lot on social activities, flexible working hours, and a good work-life balance.

• 
Flexible Work Environment: Enjoy a collaborative, inclusive, and open workplace designed to fit your needs and support work-life balance.

• 
Competitive Package: A competitive salary, an 11% company pension plan, and a comprehensive benefits package.

• 
Time to Recharge: Benefit from 32 paid vacation days and paid parental leave to focus on what matters most.

• 
Career Growth: Access professional development opportunities and grow your career in a high-impact, high-growth industry.

• 
Stay Energized: Enjoy excellent coffee, tea, free snacks, and subsidized lunches at the office.

• 
Stay Active: Use our Spirii gym and shared company car to keep moving.

• 
Make an Impact: Be part of a team driving the future of sustainable energy while working on meaningful projects.

• 
Two innovation days per month for YOU to choose what you work on.

The position is a permanent position in Copenhagen, Denmark. Danish language is not a requirement, but Fluent English language skills are required.

Celare Quantum Communications is a Danish high-tech quantum technology company with a mission to radically improve cybersecurity and enable trusted global data sharing.

Our core product is a unique, cutting-edge technology born from years of university research called Continuous-Variable Quantum Key Distribution (CV-QKD). This technology enables post-quantum secure key exchange for protecting sensitive data across critical infrastructure.

Celare partners with local and international governments, telecom operators, data centers, banks, defense ministries, and leading academic institutions. Over the past year our team has successfully launched commercial pilot deployments of our technology.

The Celare Team

We are a highly specialized and ambitious team of quantum engineers, serial entrepreneurs, laser, RF and electronics specialists, mathematicians, software engineers, and IC and FPGA designers.

Based in Copenhagen, we combine deep academic expertise with hands-on experience in launching complex, high-impact technology products.

The Role

In this role you will get a unique opportunity to work at the cutting edge of quantum technology development. You will be part of a small team of optical engineers responsible for optical development and test activities in the company. You will have a key role in our Photonic Integrated Circuit (PIC) development activities as a technical point of contact with our development partners.

As part of a small and agile organization, you will contribute across the full product lifecycle — from early architectural decisions and prototyping to production and large-scale deployment. You will work both in collaboration with our team and independently as a specialist, sharing knowledge across disciplines.

This is a hands-on role with real responsibility and influence. It offers work with an international, multilingual and multicultural dynamic team with direct connection to academic research and bleeding-edge technologies.

The role is situated on site in our Copenhagen headquarters.

Responsibilities

• Leading and carrying out various PIC development activities

• Planning and execution of PIC test activities

• Development of optical subsystems for our CV-QKD and Quantum Random Number Generator (QRNG) products

• Maintaining and extending the company’s optical laboratories

• Contributing specialist knowledge and collaborating to make the team excel at product development

Qualifications

• MSc or PhD in optics or similar

• 5+ years of work experience

• Experience with conducting experiments in fiber and/or free-space optics

• Experience with PIC technology and development

• Hands-on experience working with digital/analog electronics

• (Optional) Experience in using quantum theory

We Offer

This full-time position offers the opportunity to build and shape the future of quantum communication in collaboration with an experienced and dynamic team. We provide individual growth plans aligned with your personal preferences and motivation. We offer competitive compensation, depending on qualifications.

Contact

For more information or if you wish to apply, send an email to jobs@celare-quantum.com and mark the subject line: “Optical Engineer”.

jobs.occupation: Postdoctoral Position in Software Engineering: Program Analysis and Repository Mining
jobs.description:
A 2-year postdoctoral researcher position is available at the University of Southern Denmark (SDU) in the Software Engineering section of the Maersk Mc-Kinney Moller Institute (MMMI). The successful candidate will contribute to the VILLUM Experiment project “Is Correctness Necessary? An Experiment in Test-Free Program Repair.” The project investigates whether software bugs can be repaired using information found in the code itself, without relying on test suites or specifications. The position is available from February 1, 2027. 

The application deadline is November 15, 2026, at 11:59 PM/23:59 (CET/CEST) 

 

Project Description

Generating code is becoming cheap; establishing whether it is correct is not. Large language models can now produce and modify software at remarkable speed, and practices such as “vibe coding” are widening the gap between code generation and validation. Requiring a carefully designed test suite or specification for every generated fragment is unlikely to scale. Yet most automated repair techniques depend on exactly such a correctness oracle: without a failing test or specification, they have neither a clear repair target nor a way to assess a proposed change.

This project challenges that dependency by investigating whether software bugs can be repaired using evidence already present in the code. It will combine program analysis with patterns mined from existing software to explore whether multiple, independent sources of evidence can guide repair when tests or specifications are unavailable. The approach will be studied across different programming languages and evaluated on both real-world bugs and code modified by AI coding assistants. The broader aim is to determine when code contains enough information to support its own repair and when knowledge of the intended behavior remains essential.

 

What we offer 

We offer a dynamic and supportive research environment within an internationally recognized institute. You will join an open, collaborative team that values teamwork, professional diligence, and innovation. The Software Engineering section provides flexible work conditions and strong support for individual development, including mentorship and opportunities to expand your skills and responsibilities.

As part of the Maersk Mc-Kinney Moller Institute, our section is involved in a variety of national and European research projects and enjoys a robust network of academic and industrial partners. This position provides an opportunity to engage with these collaborations and work on real-world challenges. We encourage and support our postdocs to publish their research in renowned journals and conferences, and to engage in knowledge exchange with colleagues and external research and industrial partners. The working language is English, and we pride ourselves on a diverse, inclusive, and inspiring workplace that fosters personal and professional growth.

 

What we expect 

The appointed researcher will investigate whether software defects can be repaired without relying on test suites or specifications. The candidate will contribute to the design, implementation, and evaluation of a framework that combines program analysis with patterns mined from existing software. The work will involve experiments with real-world bugs and code modified by AI coding assistants across multiple programming languages. We are looking for a highly motivated candidate who meets the following qualifications and characteristics:

• 
A PhD (completed or close to completion) in Software Engineering, Computer Science, Programming Languages, Artificial Intelligence, or a closely related field.

• 
Research experience or a strong interest in one or more of the following areas: program analysis, mining software repositories, automated software engineering, software testing, or software repair.

• 
An interest in software reliability challenges arising from AI-generated and AI-modified code.

• 
Experience with empirical evaluation, software repositories, or bug benchmarks is an advantage.

jobs.occupation: Postdoctoral Researcher in Computational Proteomics and Machine Learning
jobs.description:
Department of Biochemistry and Molecular Biology, University of Southern Denmark
Location: Odense, Denmark
Duration: 2 years, with the possibility of a 1-year extension
Starting Date: 1 January 2027, or as soon as possible thereafter

Project Description
We invite applications for a postdoctoral position at the interface of computational proteomics, machine learning, and mass spectrometry. The successful candidate will join a pioneering research program focused on peptide ionization and fragmentation in LC-MS/MS, with the aim of developing new computational approaches for peptide fragmentation analysis.

The project centers on large-scale, experimentally curated tandem mass spectrometry datasets and the development of new computational strategies for fragmentation analysis under analytically underexplored conditions. It relies on modern machine learning approaches to model fragmentation behavior, support spectral interpretation, and enable future advances in peptide identification workflows.

The position is embedded in the Protein Research Group (PRG) at the University of Southern Denmark, an internationally recognized environment in proteomics and biological mass spectrometry. The postdoctoral researcher will work in close collaboration with experimental colleagues generating high-quality tandem MS data for computational development.

Research Environment and Collaborative Structure
The Protein Research Group comprises eight PI-led teams and more than 50 researchers and students, offering a highly interactive and interdisciplinary research environment. The successful candidate will play a central role in the computational arm of the project and will collaborate closely with experimental researchers developing new mass spectrometric methods and generating large-scale fragmentation datasets.

The position offers substantial scientific independence and the opportunity to help shape a new research direction at the intersection of machine learning, peptide chemistry, and proteomics.

Responsibilities
The postdoctoral researcher will be expected to:

• 
Develop computational and machine learning workflows for large-scale analysis of tandem mass spectrometry data 

• 
Contribute to the structuring, curation, and quality control of large experimental MS/MS datasets 

• 
Build data-driven models for peptide fragmentation analysis using experimentally generated spectra 

• 
Integrate relevant variables such as peptide sequence, precursor charge state, collision energy, and peptide modifications into computational frameworks 

• 
Evaluate model performance using suitable similarity, quality, and generalization metrics 

• 
Contribute to the extension of computational models toward chemically and biologically relevant peptide classes, including selected post-translational modifications 

• 
Investigate how computational models may help reveal fragmentation trends and chemically meaningful patterns in large-scale MS/MS datasets 

• 
Work independently on model development, implementation, and computational problem solving, while interacting closely with experimental researchers in the group 

• 
Contribute to reproducible and well-documented computational pipelines, data structures, and analysis workflows 

• 
Disseminate findings through peer-reviewed publications, conference presentations, and open scientific resources where relevant 

Required Qualifications
Applicants must have:

• 
A PhD in computational proteomics, bioinformatics, machine learning, computer science, chemometrics, analytical chemistry, or a closely related field 

• 
Strong experience in machine learning and/or deep learning applied to complex scientific datasets 

• 
Demonstrated ability to independently develop computational solutions, including model design, implementation, evaluation, and documentation 

• 
Proficiency in Python and relevant machine learning/data science frameworks 

• 
Experience with data preprocessing, curation, and quality control for large and complex datasets 

• 
A strong analytical mindset and the ability to work independently on computational research problems 

• 
Interest in working at the interface of computation, chemistry, and mass spectrometry 

Desirable Qualifications
The following qualifications will be considered an advantage:

• 
Experience with mass spectrometry-based proteomics, computational mass spectrometry, or peptide fragmentation-related data analysis 

• 
Experience with neural network architectures relevant for sequence-based prediction tasks 

• 
Experience with model interpretability, explainable AI, or feature analysis in scientific machine learning 

• 
Interest in peptide chemistry, gas-phase ion behavior, or post-translational modifications 

• 
Experience with reproducible workflows, FAIR data principles, and scalable computational pipelines 

• 
Ability to collaborate effectively across computational and experimental disciplines 

What We Offer
A unique opportunity to work at the intersection of proteomics, mass spectrometry, and machine learning on scientifically ambitious and methodologically innovative research 

• 
The opportunity to develop computational methods for experimentally generated high-quality tandem mass spectrometry data 

• 
A central and independent role in shaping the computational direction of a new research effort 

• 
Close collaboration with experimental researchers working on peptide ionization, fragmentation, and advanced LC-MS/MS method development 

• 
A strong interdisciplinary research environment with expertise spanning proteomics, biological mass spectrometry, peptide chemistry, and data analysis 

• 
Access to state-of-the-art mass spectrometry platforms and large in-house datasets 

• 
An international and collaborative research culture with opportunities for scientific development, publication, and conference participation 

• 
Competitive salary and benefits according to Danish collective agreements, including pension and support for international candidates where relevant 

About the Protein Research Group
The Protein Research Group at SDU is internationally recognized for pioneering work in biological mass spectrometry, peptide and protein chemistry, gas-phase chemistry, and proteomics. Research in the group spans fundamental analytical chemistry, method development, structural biology, post-translational modifications, and translational applications in biomedicine and biotechnology.

Located in Odense, the group offers an open, collaborative, and ambitious research environment with a strong emphasis on scientific rigor, interdisciplinary exchange, and long-term platform building. The successful candidate will join a setting in which computational and experimental researchers work in close interaction.

Application deadline: 16. November 2026 at 23:59 hours local Danish time. 

Please see the full call, including how to apply, on www.sdu.dk

This position is open for candidates located in Warsaw (PL) area or Odense (DK) area.

Are you passionate about quality, GMP compliance, and supporting successful product launches and technology transfers?

At Orifarm, we are looking for a dedicated Quality Assurance Specialist to join our Innovation & Launch team. You will provide QA support across product launches and technology transfers, ensuring compliance with GMP requirements, internal procedures, and regulatory expectations.

You will work closely with internal stakeholders and Contract Manufacturing Organizations (CMOs) to secure compliant and efficient implementation of new products and processes.

About the job

As QA Specialist, you will support product launches and technology transfers from a QA perspective. You will provide quality oversight, collaborate across functions and help ensure compliant and timely product supply while balancing quality requirements with business priorities.

Key responsibilities:

• Providing QA support and oversight for product launches and technology transfers.

• Collaborating with CMOs and internal stakeholders to ensure timely and compliant implementation.

Who are you?

You thrive in a fast-paced environment where quality, compliance, and business needs must be balanced. You are structured, detail-oriented, and comfortable taking ownership of complex tasks.

We expect that you:

• Have experience from QA/QC, manufacturing, process support, or another GMP-regulated environment.

• Experience with manufacturing documentation is an advantage.

• Have solid knowledge of EU GMP requirements.

• Can work independently and manage multiple priorities.

• Possess strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

• Communicate fluently in English, both written and spoken.

• Enjoy collaborating across functions and cultures.

Who are we?

You will become part of a skilled and collaborative QA organization where professionalism, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement are central to how we work.

In Innovation & Launch, we support product launches and technology transfers across Orifarm’s international supply network. We work closely with manufacturing sites, CMOs, project teams, and commercial stakeholders to ensure products reach the market with the right quality and at the right time.

What we offer?

• A key quality role with significant responsibility and impact.

• International collaboration across manufacturing sites and partners.

• A high degree of independence and flexibility.

• Opportunities for professional growth and development.

Odense (DK) or Warsaw (PL).

Why should you join Orifarm?

At Orifarm, we are united by a shared purpose: improving access to affordable medicine for the people who need it. Rather than developing new medicines, we focus on finding smarter ways to bring existing treatments to patients, creating value for pharmacies, healthcare systems, and society.

We live by the mindset Challenge Accepted. It reflects our explorer spirit and can-do attitude, where challenges are perceived as opportunities. We encourage people to ask questions, challenge assumptions, and take ownership. Across teams, functions, and markets, you will find a collaborative and supportive culture built on trust, respect, and a flat hierarchy where everyone has a voice and direct access to decision-makers.

When you join Orifarm, you will be empowered to make a real impact from day one. We offer autonomy and great opportunities for career advancement, enabling our employees to shape their professional development. We value flexibility and provide a hybrid work model with the possibility of working from home two days a week.

We invite you to join Orifarm, if you are curious, ambitious, and accept the challenge of bringing better deals of medicine to millions.

We encourage everyone to apply

At Orifarm, we welcome people from all backgrounds, recognizing that the best outcomes come from a diverse and inclusive work environment. Our commitment is to create an environment where different perspectives and skills drive innovation and contribute to a sustainable future. By creating such an environment, we are confident that we can achieve better results together.

jobs.occupation: Continuing Airworthiness Management Organisation (CAMO) Manager – JoinJet
jobs.description:
Are you experienced in continuing airworthiness management and motivated by ensuring safe, efficient and reliable aircraft operations? Do you have strong leadership skills, a technical mindset and an interest in optimizing maintenance planning, costs and processes?

Then you may be our new Continuing Airworthiness Management Organisation (CAMO) Manager.

As CAMO Manager at JoinJet, you will have an exciting and responsible position with a key role in ensuring the continued airworthiness of our aircraft fleet. You will be responsible for planning and following up on maintenance activities and for ensuring that our aircraft are maintained to the highest standards, enabling safe and efficient operations.

You will also be responsible for ensuring that the applicable rules and regulations are implemented and maintained within JoinJet’s CAMO and that the organisation remains compliant with its CAME.

Your responsibilities

Your main tasks and areas of responsibility will include:

· Overseeing all standard continuing airworthiness management functions

· Managing and maintaining the technical documentation for all aircraft

· Responsible for long-term maintenance planning and budgeting

· Ensuring efficient maintenance planning and minimizing aircraft downtime

· Driving LEAN initiatives and continuous improvement of CAMO processes

· Maintaining the technical dialogue with aviation authorities

· Ensuring that the aircraft remain airworthy and compliant with all applicable technical and regulatory requirements

· Monitoring and optimizing maintenance costs and aircraft utilization

· Leading and developing the CAMO team

· Acting as the technical point of contact for relevant internal and external stakeholders

· Performing ad hoc tasks and projects related to CAMO and technical operations

The position reports to the Accountable Manager and works closely with JoinJet and SUN-AIR Technic on technical and operational matters.

Expectations

You have experience from a similar position with management responsibility and at least five years of relevant experience, preferably with at least two years in an administrative or management position within the aviation industry.

You have a solid understanding of airworthiness, maintenance and quality systems and are comfortable using IT as an integral part of your daily work. You have broad technical knowledge and practical experience from aviation, combined with a structured and business-oriented approach.

As the Nominated Postholder for CAMO, you will have overall leadership responsibility for the CAMO department.

A background as an aircraft technician is an advantage.

As a person

You are a natural leader who motivates and develops your employees through trust, clear communication and delegation. You have good interpersonal skills and enjoy working collaboratively across departments.

You are not afraid to challenge existing processes and look for better and more efficient ways of working. You are solution-oriented, structured and take pride in delivering high-quality work.

You have a good sense of humour and contribute positively to the working environment. You have a basic understanding of finance and a sound commercial mindset.

You are proficient in Microsoft Office and communicate confidently in both Danish and English, verbally and in writing.

Some travel activity should be expected in the position, although it will be limited.

Please note that you must have a residence and work permit that allows you to live and work in Denmark.

We offer

We offer an exciting and challenging position in an international business aviation company, where you will have the opportunity to develop both professionally and personally.

You will become part of an experienced team and have the opportunity to take an active role in the continued development of our CAMO organisation and the business as a whole.

We also offer:

· A responsible and varied full-time position

· An international working environment

· Excellent office facilities and canteen

· Competitive salary according to qualifications

· Pension scheme

· Opportunities for professional and personal development

How to apply

If you find the position interesting, we would be pleased to hear from you.

Please send us your application and CV through the application link as soon as possible. Applications are accepted in both Danish and English.

If you have any questions regarding the position, please contact us on +45 76 500 100.

We look forward to welcoming you on board JoinJet.

Fly the way you like.

JoinJet is headquartered in Billund and arranges individual flights for, for example, VIPs, companies, bands, sports clubs, etc. JoinJet also manages private and commercial aircraft, as well as aircraft sales and leasing and FBO service, which are part of JoinJet's business areas. With over 30 years of experience, the company understands the diverse needs of its customers, and its products are tailored to meet those needs. JoinJet always focuses on quality and precision. JoinJet is part of the Sundberg Aviation Group, and from the headquarters in Billund, the group's business areas are managed, which today include air ambulance service worldwide, corporate shuttles, aircraft maintenance, spare parts sales, charter flights, as well as international aircraft sales and leasing.
